description: This file defines the JobSpecificationModel class within the OrangeHRM Admin API. It represents a data model for job specification attachments, including schema annotations for API documentation, and implements normalization traits for serialization. The class encapsulates an entity of type PartialJobSpecificationAttachment and configures attribute filters and names for API responses.

classes.name: JobSpecificationModel
classes.description: A model class for representing job specification data in the API, with serialization and schema annotations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a PartialJobSpecificationAttachment entity and sets up attribute filters and names for API serialization.
